[[Raw Amber Chunks]] are found in two [[mission]]s in the [[Echovald Forest]]. They play an important role in these missions and should not be ignored.

===[[Fort Aspenwood]]===
They are found at the orange and purple [[Amber Mine]]s just outside the Kurzick fort. They are a [[Bundle]] that should be carried to [[Master Architect Gunther]] or either of the Kurzick gatekeepers. If brought to the master architect, it will add +2% towards the creation of the [[Gods' Vengeance]] superweapon, reducing the time that the Kurzicks need to hold against the attacking Luxons. If brought to one of the gate keepers, they will repair the innermost destroyed gate on his side, resurrecting its guard NPCs.

===[[Altrumm Ruins]]===
They are dropped by killed enemies. They are not a bundle in this mission -- clicking on them makes them disappear and adds to the score directly. Like [[Refined Amber Chunks]], they provide 1 point and 15 [[Kurzick faction]].
